#!/bin/sh
set -e

if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Linux" ]; then
    echo "deployment requires a Linux host" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Create service user (portable: works on glibc and busybox)
if id fixture >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[deploy] user 'fixture' exists"
else
    echo "[deploy] creating user 'fixture'"
    if command -v useradd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        sudo useradd -r -m -d /home/fixture -s /bin/sh fixture
    elif command -v adduser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        sudo adduser -D -h /home/fixture -s /bin/sh fixture 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi

# Create directories
sudo mkdir -p /opt/tt/bin /opt/tt/etc /home/fixture/ctl /srv/images /home/fixture/data /home/fixture/run

# Install binaries
sudo install -m 755 /tmp/ttstack-deploy.fixture/tt-agent /opt/tt/bin/.tt-agent.new
sudo mv -f /opt/tt/bin/.tt-agent.new /opt/tt/bin/tt-agent

# Set ownership
sudo chown fixture:fixture /home/fixture /home/fixture/ctl

# Detect init system and install service
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d /run/systemd/system ]; then
    echo "[deploy] using systemd"
    # Migrate documented mount guards from a previously edited generated unit.
    if [ -f /etc/systemd/system/tt-agent.service ]; then
        guards=$(sudo awk '/^RequiresMountsFor=/ {u=u $0 "\n"} /^ExecStartPre=.*mountpoint/ {s=s $0 "\n"} END {if (u != "" || s != "") printf "[Unit]\n%s[Service]\n%s",u,s}' /etc/systemd/system/tt-agent.service)
        if [ -n "$guards" ]; then
            sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/tt-agent.service.d
            printf '%s\n' "$guards" | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/tt-agent.service.d/90-ttstack-mounts.conf >/dev/null
        fi
    fi
    sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/tt-agent.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=TTstack tt-agent
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
# VM processes must survive agent restarts
KillMode=process
TimeoutStopSec=360
Environment=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
ExecStart=/opt/tt/bin/tt-agent --listen 0.0.0.0:9100
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

UNIT
    sudo systemctl daemon-reload
    sudo systemctl enable tt-agent
    sudo systemctl restart tt-agent
    sleep 1
    sudo systemctl is-active tt-agent && echo "[deploy] tt-agent is active"
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[deploy] using OpenRC"
    sudo tee /etc/init.d/tt-agent > /dev/null <<'INITD'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="tt-agent"
description="TTstack tt-agent"
command="/opt/tt/bin/tt-agent"
command_args="--listen 0.0.0.0:9100"
supervisor="supervise-daemon"
respawn_delay=5
respawn_max=0
pidfile="/run/${name}.pid"
output_log="/var/log/${name}.log"
error_log="/var/log/${name}.log"

depend() {
    need net
    after firewall
}

INITD
    sudo chmod 755 /etc/init.d/tt-agent
    sudo rc-update add tt-agent default 2>/dev/null || true
    sudo rc-service tt-agent restart 2>/dev/null || sudo rc-service tt-agent start
    sleep 1
    sudo rc-service tt-agent status && echo "[deploy] tt-agent is running"
else
    echo "[deploy] WARNING: no known init system; starting tt-agent manually"
    sudo pkill -x 'tt-agent' 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 1
    sudo nohup sh -c '/opt/tt/bin/tt-agent --listen 0.0.0.0:9100' > /var/log/tt-agent.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 2
    pgrep -x 'tt-agent' && echo "[deploy] tt-agent started (manual)"
fi

# Cleanup
rm -rf /tmp/ttstack-deploy.fixture
echo "[deploy] tt-agent deployed on testhost"
